newsitem.title: USA: US state legislators set conference on electricity.
newsitem.headline: US state legislators set conference on electricity.

text.p: The National Conference of State Legislatures has scheduled conference on the future of the electric power industry, New York Assembly Speaker Sheldon Silver said Friday.

He said the conference, to be held May 29 and 30 at the Grand Hyatt hotel in New York City, will focus on the introduction of compeition into the generation of electricity. the meeting will is expected to draw state legislators from across the nation, along with utility expects, representatives of electric utilities and consumer groups, he added. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
